scope: Bounded native K=2 fixed-geometry nonspeculative proof; no full decoder build, no LocalMaxxing submission, no record claim.
timing_metric: Median across five unique cache-zero 128-token requests of 1000 * post_ttft_s / (completion_tokens - 1).

post_profiler_repeated_prompt_support_on.reason_not_primary: The timing prompts had already been used before and the profiler run intervened. This row is support only, not a gate or record result.

definition.effective_boundary: literal submit plus direct immediate launch, memory-copy, signal-event, and wait-event appends
definition.host_sync: command-list, event, and fence host synchronizations

residual_3_435_ms_split.qualification: Only the Level Zero active time, argmax host scope, and device metadata events are directly separable in the valid graph-on PTI trace. The remainder is a conservative upper bound containing Python segment iteration, profiler-invisible host metadata production, and scheduler/queue gap; it is not claimed as pure Python time. Long event-host waits are device completion waits and are excluded from removable host API active time.

cold_capture_negative_result.detail: The first live capture request compiled four Triton kernels inside capture and diverged at token index 2: 2/3 oracle-prefix token IDs matched, then the candidate emitted token 0 instead of EOS and continued. The next four requests, including rollover, were exact. An explicit out-of-suite capture warmup is therefore mandatory.

bounded_design.fixed_address_metadata: The first real eligible request captures the raw K=2 transaction using live fixed-address attention/KV buffers; the second step advances device-resident positions, slot mappings, and attention metadata inside capture.
bounded_design.argmax: Each TP rank writes one row in a compact float32 pair bank; graph-recordable SUM all-reduce reconstructs the bank and device argmax selects the canonical rank-order winner. No host all-gather is used in the captured transaction.
bounded_design.literal_limit: One graph replay is submitted per K=2 worker turn, not per token. Host input/output bookkeeping outside the graph remains, so the proof reaches 33 effective boundaries/token rather than one.

empirical_k2_amortization_extrapolation.method: Double the same-suite K=2 recovery as the K->infinity fixed per-turn amortization limit.

projected_full_decoder_ceiling.qualification: Ceilings only; neither was built or measured.
